# B519 — a module-level `let` GENERATED BY A MACRO in an IMPORTED module is never emitted on JS: a `[service(Client)]` declared outside the entry file calls `origin_source(__mirrors_Client_method, ..)` and the table's declaration is missing — `ReferenceError: __mirrors_KoltClient_get_channels is not defined` in the browser

- status: OPEN — filed 2026-10-02 (the owner's report on kolt; reproduced and reduced by the integrator); lane fix-45, BEFORE the v0.43.0 cut
- kind: MISCOMPILE (JS; HIGH) — the owner's app throws at run time
- area: Type system & the type solver

Reproduces on v0.42.1, on next @d2e3fa04, and on kolt's committed HEAD — so every release since A134 (v0.42.0) breaks a service declared in a non-entry module the first time a handle-returning stub is called. A plain hand-written module-level `let` in an imported module IS emitted (control). Every A134 pin is a single-file program, which is why no gate saw it. Suspects: the macro-expansion's module-level bindings are appended after the reachability / init-order pass has decided what a non-entry module contributes; or the generated `let` is unexported under `export *;` semantics and reach drops it. Fix + pins with the service in an imported module (JS run, both `vilan build` legs, and native if the native client path exists); sweep for other macro-generated module-level bindings with the same shape (`[derive]`s, `css`, `Style`). Sizing S–M.
